raw_note: beacon-toolkit-branch-governance doctor returns Beacon source repo governance, not target project sub-service governance. Running 'beacon doctor branch-governance show --version v2.0.0 --project-root .' from Rolo project root resolves to beacon repo (feature/v1.5.2), not rolo/marketing_primary_fe contracts. Sub-services have no deterministic governance surface.
